annotations.title: Gross yield on two bases, by month

description:
Gross rental yield for an area and bedroom band on two bases, by month,
    with n: `gross_yield_asking` (12 × the month's median asking rent ÷ the
    median asking price of sale listings in the same area, band and month —
    different properties) and `gross_yield_avm_median` (the median, over rent
    listings matched to a property, of 12 × asking rent ÷ our valuation of
    that property; `gross_yield_avm_n` behind it). Both rest on ASKING rents,
    not achieved ones. Null where a month is too thin to publish — say so
    rather than averaging around it. `latest` is the most recent month with a
    figure. The basis sentence comes with it.
    UK only. Free.
name: market_yields
title: Gross yield on two bases, by month
